RU2097274C1 - Electrically-Driven Craft

Abstract

Field: Heavier-than-air flying vehicles.
Substance: The craft includes a case (1) on whose surface a layer (2) made from superconducting material is applied, and electric insulators (3) are mounted for a superconducting winding (4) with sections of electromagnetic shields located together in a hermetic casing-fairing (6).
Effect: Enhanced efficiency. (2 drawings)

Description

The invention relates to electrically-driven vehicles, primarily used as propulsion for underwater, surface, air, and space flights up to stars with entry into their atmospheres, as well as in the atmospheres of Venus and giant planets, and in the plasma shells of comets.

Section below is most important part how UFOs do what they do and on what principles. This document is translated by Grok so there are maybe some mistranslations just so you know.

The vehicle is given motion in the selected direction by activating the sections of the shields (5) on those sections of the winding (4) where the currents would counteract the action of the Earth's magnetic field or other medium currents on the vehicle at its location.

The thrust force of the electrically-driven vehicle is created by expelling the magnetic field of the external environment (in air, by the Earth's magnetic field) by the current in the unshielded sections of the winding.

At the same time, the current shell in the superconducting coating (2) of the hull creates radiation protection for the crew of the vehicle, as well as gravitational protection, since the surface currents of the hull draw the neutrino ether into circulation around the vehicle and create its own atmosphere and its own gravitational field for the vehicle, thereby creating weightlessness inside the hull, similar to the plasma core of the Earth.
